Lullwave Sleep Sounds and Colored Noise ​

Lullwave is an Android app with colored noise and calming ambient sounds for sleep, relaxation, focus, and sound masking. Choose a steady noise color or listen to familiar sounds such as rain, flowing water, sea waves, a train, or a fireplace.

No registration or subscription is required.

Download Lullwave for Android ​

Colored noise for sleep, relaxation, and focus ​

Different noise colors distribute sound energy across frequencies in different ways. This gives each one a distinct character:

  • Brown noise has a deep, low-frequency sound.
  • Pink noise has a balanced, softer character.
  • White noise spreads energy evenly across frequencies.
  • Blue noise emphasizes higher frequencies.
  • Purple noise has an even brighter high-frequency character.

Lullwave also includes mixes of noise waves and noise pulses, making it easy to find a background sound that suits your environment.

Ambient and nature sound library ​

Alongside colored noise, the app offers a range of continuous ambient sounds:

  • Flowing water streams
  • Rain sounds
  • Sea waves
  • Water droplets
  • Boiling water
  • Train sounds
  • Fireplace sounds

These sounds can provide a consistent audio backdrop for winding down, reading, working, or masking distracting environmental noise.

A simple sound app without an account ​

Lullwave focuses on quick access to its sound library. You do not need to create an account, register, or manage a subscription before choosing a noise or ambient sound.
